findings.detail: Disabled account still has assigned licenses.
findings.recommendation: Review license assignment and remove unused licenses if no exception exists.

findings.detail: Guest account has no sign-in within 30 days.
findings.recommendation: Ask the sponsor to approve continued access or remove the guest.

findings.detail: Enabled member account has no manager value.
findings.recommendation: Update the manager attribute to support approvals and access reviews.

findings.detail: Group does not have an owner recorded in the export.
findings.recommendation: Assign a business owner before the next access review.

findings.detail: Guest has membership in sensitive group 'Finance SharePoint Members'.
findings.recommendation: Require owner approval or remove the guest from the group.

findings.detail: Principal has eligible assignment to 'Global Administrator'. The principal account is disabled.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the role assignment is still required and covered by an access review.

findings.detail: Principal has active assignment to 'User Administrator'.
findings.recommendation: Confirm the role assignment is still required and covered by an access review.
